protocol.lower_endpoint: strictly greater than .65; other lower endpoints inclusive; upper endpoints exclusive

continuation.reset: other, different action, prior reject, gap, generation change

protocol.truth: Historical reviewed labels plus exact human-labelled 736 crowded windows; no pseudo other, excluded or conflicted windows
protocol.scope: Paired causal offline replay of frozen current production probabilities; no production edits or promotion
protocol.delay: Running: first qualifying subthreshold candidate to confirmation on source timeline; continuation no additional future-frame wait; not camera-to-display latency
protocol.selection: Fixed declared rules; no selecting settings by held-out test results
protocol.source_separation: old train/val/test and new human feedback separately; all historically viewed, not untouched blind test
